messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout v3.6.1 -> 8% (regions: global). Initiator: ara. Cmd: `/deploy start --version v3.6.1 --percent 8`

ara: launching canary now. preflight green. watching p50/p99 and 4xx/5xx.

alert-bot: ALERT: ap-northeast increased 4xx rate to 1.2% (baseline 0.4%). Top error: tokenizer_fallback_error.

devon: seeing it too. traces point to new fallback path for mixed-script inputs. Suggest PAUSE and pin to ap-northeast while we triage.

ara: Agreed HOLD for that region. If we can hotfix fallback we prefer config revert -> small blast.

ops-sre: Vote: HOLD. Pinning scope ap-northeast. Rollback criteria: sustained error rate >1.0% for 5m OR p99 latency > 600ms for 3m. Rollback command: `/deploy rollback --version v3.6.0 --percent 100`.

devon: I'll open revert PR for fallback and test in staging. If green in 10-15m, we can unpin and continue.

deploy-bot: Action: `/release pin v3.6.1 --scope ap-northeast --reason "tokenizer fallback errors" --initiator ara` applied. Percent bumps disabled for pinned scope. Thread state: PAUSED (pinned).

ara: Posting short support blurb: "Investigating increased 4xx errors in AP-Northeast related to tokenizer fallback for mixed-script inputs. Engineers triaging; mitigation in flight."

ops-sre: Keep channel updated. If revert doesn't stabilize within 20m, prepare rollback execution and customer comms.
